sections.title: Report
rows: charge-period span covers the month (day-level gaps not checked)
Amounts are never summed or converted across currencies; no FX is applied
Scope: supplied file(s) and periods; not a complete provider invoice; reconciled only against the control totals shown
FOCUS BilledCost: the invoiced amount, after Credit and Adjustment rows
FOCUS EffectiveCost: the amortized cost after discounts; partial or N/A where rows lack it
Credit and Adjustment rows (FOCUS ChargeCategory) are included once in both the billed and the effective totals, and are also listed separately
